description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Relativity Space is hiring a Software Engineer I for its Factory Platform team. The role builds full-stack applications, data pipelines, and dashboards that support design and manufacturing engineers, automate workflows, and improve visibility into factory operations.
Software Engineer I building company-wide factory applications, automating telemetry analysis and creating production-planning tools and manufacturing dashboards

Responsibilities:
• As a Software Engineer I on the Factory Platform team, you will build applications that directly support design and manufacturing engineers across the company
• You'll work on projects like automating the analysis of telemetry data streaming from test stands, building tools to streamline supply chain and production planning processes, and creating dashboards that give engineers real-time visibility into manufacturing operations
• You will participate in the full software development lifecycle, from understanding user requirements to designing, implementing, testing, and deploying solutions
• You'll work across the stack—building responsive front-ends, scalable back-ends, and data pipelines that connect systems together
• You'll follow agile development practices, write quality code that is continuously integrated and deployed, and iterate based on feedback from the engineers and operators who use your tools every day

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or a related engineering field (Computer, Software, Electrical, Aerospace)
• Strong computer science foundations: data structures, algorithms, systems, and clean, testable code
• 1+ years of professional software development experience (including internships, co-ops, or substantial academic/personal projects you have shipped)
• Experience building web applications with modern frameworks and languages
• Comfortable working across the full stack—front-end, back-end, and data layers
• Eager to learn new technologies and tools to solve real problems
• Excited to work directly with engineers and operators on the factory floor to understand their needs and iterate on solutions
• Candidates should have completed their degree requirements and be available to begin full-time employment within **30–60 days of applying.** If your availability falls outside this window, we encourage you to return and apply when you are within **30–60 days of being available to start full-time employment.**

Preferred:
• Experience with React or other modern front-end frameworks
• Familiarity with data engineering tools and working with large datasets
• Exposure to manufacturing, hardware, test and measurement systems, or other physical-world domains
• Experience building dashboards, data visualizations, or analytics tools
• Contributions to open-source projects or experience shipping software products end-to-end
